Subject: FY28 target-setting: trade-offs, risk owners, and QBR narrative

Team —

Kickoff note for FY28 targets. I attached a short assumptions workbook and a draft QBR narrative outline to help frame what we need from each pod this week. High-level asks:

1) By EOD Wednesday (4/28) please send: top 3 target scenarios (aggressive / base / conservative) with one-line assumptions and the primary risk owner.
2) Identify any material trade-offs (latency vs. unit cost, Hosted vs. Dedicated capacity) that change the FY28 topline for your area.
3) If you expect procurement or legal gating (Acme / SageCorp pilots, contract redlines), flag it here and add an ETA.

I'm scheduling a 45-minute leadership sync on Friday (4/30) to lock the narrative and the QBR deck skeleton — invite to follow.

Attachments: [FY28_assumptions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - 120KB), QBR_narrative_outline_v0.3.pptx (slides - 640KB)]

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Operations
